item.title: 4 FIRs over INDIA bloc march; takedown request for 500 pieces of content
item.description: Delhi Police have filed four FIRs regarding protests linked to the INDIA bloc and associated violations. These cases involve barricade violations and road defacement, according to police sources. Additionally, four FIRs pertain to disinformation initiatives believed to be linked to social media accounts based in Pakistan. Investigators are focusing on over 100 suspicious social media handles aiming to spread anti-India narratives.
item.dc:creator: ABHAY

item.title: CJP’s Das, Ranka sent to Tihar Jail for 5 days over Jantar Mantar trespass
item.description: Cockroach Janata Party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were arrested for violating protest-related regulations. They allegedly breached barricades and entered a protest site designated for demonstrations. Their arrests are a response to ongoing protests against alleged irregularities in electoral rolls. The Delhi Police recently designated new protest venues, moving demonstrations away from the political center. The CJP criticized this move, claiming it weakens public dissent visibility.
item.dc:creator: HADI KHAN

item.title: Bittu Tabahi ‘heartbroken’ after finding garbage in river he cleaned for 8 months
item.description: Bittu Tabahi's return to the Ajnar River after an eight-month cleanup revealed a heartbreaking reality; the river was heavily polluted again. In a poignant video, he shared his frustration and vowed to keep documenting the situation. Previously, he successfully removed large quantities of waste from the Yamuna and surrounding areas, yet the formidable challenge of sustaining these clean-ups amid persistent pollution persists.
item.dc:creator: PRACHI KUMAWAT

item.title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi drops two-word message ahead of India vs West Indies 4th T20I
item.description: India will look to seal the five-match T20I series when they face the West Indies in the fourth match at the Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium in Hyderabad on Wednesday. With India leading the series 2-1, the possibility of 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi getting a chance has once again become a major talking point.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar has ‘AI theory’ for researchers taking up smoking
item.description: Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar claims some AI researchers in Silicon Valley are taking up smoking to show how strongly they believe AI will cure cancer. Speaking in a US TV interview, he said many in the industry have filled a "god-shaped hole" with the "machine God of AGI," and blamed effective altruism for fuelling AI doomsday fears.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: 13 dead as boat capsizes in Ganga in Bihar’s Vaishali, several missing
item.description: In a heart-wrenching event in the Raghopur Diara vicinity of Vaishali district, a boat capsized, tragically involving many children. The local community is in distress, with RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav voicing his grief and urging immediate rescue actions. The administration is actively working to hasten relief efforts and support victims, while officials keep a vigilant watch on the unfolding situation.

item.title: Delhi man beaten to death for spilling beer on club manager's wife
item.description: A 29-year-old driver named Daljeet Singh was killed after an altercation at a club in Delhi. The incident began when he accidentally spilled beer on the club manager's wife during her birthday celebration. Following a violent confrontation, Daljeet and his friends were assaulted by the club staff. After returning home, Daljeet fell ill, prompting his wife to take him to the hospital.
item.dc:creator: ABHAY

item.title: Is asking wife to wash clothes and utensils cruelty? Bombay HC explains Section 498A
item.description: The Bombay high court addressed a case regarding cruelty allegations under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code. The court found that asking a woman to wash clothes and utensils did not amount to cruelty. Additionally, it quashed the charges against six relatives due to vague allegations lacking specifics. The court noted that the relatives lived separately from the woman and her claims lacked detail.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH THAKUR

item.title: Billionaire wins tax reversal over A$280m Tasmania dairy farm
item.description: A Full Court in Tasmania has overturned a significant tax assessment against companies related to Xianfeng Lu. The decision cancels a A$23.4 million stamp duty bill that included penalties and interest. This dispute originated from the 2016 purchase of the Woolnorth dairy estate, bought for A$280 million. The ruling removes a major financial liability for the companies managing the property in north-west Tasmania.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Shreveport glass plant demolition to recycle 95% of steel, brick and concrete
item.description: Full-scale demolition of the former Libbey Glass plant in Shreveport is now underway and progressing. Environmental contaminants have been cleared over the 54-acre site, allowing for redevelopment opportunities. Demolition teams are set to dismantle the industrial silos that have dominated the skyline for decades. Local authorities expect increased truck traffic around Jewella Avenue until mid-2027 due to construction activities.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: US issues power grid emergency in 13 states: Reason and what it means for residents
item.description: In response to heightened electricity demands driven by weather fluctuations and maintenance outages, U.S. Secretary of Energy Chris Wright has issued an emergency order permitting PJM Interconnection to activate essential power generation units. This directive, effective from October 13 to 16, aims to stabilize the grid. Residents may be asked to conserve energy by limiting non-essential usage, particularly during peak hours across 13 states and D.C.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Iowa farmer says crops barely cover taxes; solar leases offer $1,200 an acre
item.description: Tom Green, an Iowa farmer, backs the Folsom Lake Solar Project after it secured the green light from the Mills County Zoning Board. This initiative is set to ensure reliable income through long-term land leases amid tough farming conditions. It promises to produce a substantial amount of electricity, enough to power many local homes, while also creating jobs and boosting tax revenues.

item.title: What Chinese pilots revealed about Rafale, MiG-29 after Egypt air drills
item.description: In a recent collaborative military drill named Eagles of Civilization 2026, Chinese pilots participated in air combat exercises with Egyptian Rafale and MiG-29 aircraft in Egypt. The focus was on enhancing close-range manoeuvring skills and electronic warfare tactics. The J-16 fighters, supported by KJ-500 airborne early warning aircraft, displayed their strengths in simulated combat, while Egyptian pilots took special interest in the electronic jamming techniques demonstrated by the Chinese force.

item.title: Taxman adds Rs 55.2 lakh over joint Rs 80 lakh property; ITAT grants relief
item.description: A man bought a residential property jointly with his wife and his father. The Income Tax Department reopened his assessment for the 2016-17 assessment year after receiving information through its Risk Management Strategy that he had purchased an immovable property during the 2015-16 financial year. The man then approached the ITAT, challenging both the addition and the calculation underlying it.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: 'My name used without permission': Dhawan to take legal action against league
item.description: Former India cricketer Shikhar Dhawan has denied participating in an upcoming franchise T20 league, claiming organisers used his name without his knowledge or permission. In a post on X, he said his team would take appropriate legal action and urged the media and fans to ignore unauthorised announcements. Dhawan has represented India across all three international cricket formats.
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: 6 teams, Rs 25k reward: Hunt on for model Shraddha Dubey in UP bizman's death case
item.description: Shiva Sharma, a 27-year-old cafe owner, died after a fall from an apartment in Lucknow. Police initiated a murder investigation following a complaint from Sharma’s family about his suspected assault. The live-in partner, Shraddha Dubey, along with four others, has been booked in connection to the case. Family members alleged that Sharma was held captive and tortured before his death.
item.dc:creator: HADI KHAN

item.title: Russia detains Japanese journalist for spying on strategic island
item.description: Imai Yuki, a Japanese journalist, finds himself in a precarious situation after being detained in Russia, where the Federal Security Service has accused him of espionage linked to military intelligence gathering. This development arises against a backdrop of rising tensions between Japan and Russia, especially due to the ongoing Ukraine conflict. Japan's classification as an 'unfriendly' nation complicates matters further, intensifying the diplomatic rift.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: US secretary of state Rubio to visit India next week for strategic, energy talks
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is set to embark on a visit to Mumbai and Jamnagar from October 17 to 22, during which he will engage in discussions aimed at enhancing strategic alliances and advancing energy collaborations. He plans to meet with key government officials and business leaders to uncover new investment opportunities.
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: Iran shifts tactics, steps up ship attacks to pressure Trump before US midterms
item.description: Iran has altered its approach by focusing on attacks against commercial shipping in the Gulf region, aiming to boost global oil prices. This tactic is designed to apply economic pressure on the United States and its allies, complicating their strategies just ahead of the midterm elections. As tensions rise, the risk to multiple vessels may increase, potentially affecting energy costs for American consumers.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: India's tour of NZ: Prasidh Krishna, Harshit Rana's fitness delays team selection
item.description: TOI understands that Krishna has been given a three-week timeline when he reported to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) after he walked out of the second ODI against West Indies in Guwahati on Sept 30. Seam-bowling allrounder Rana, who has been at the CoE since July, is expected to undergo a return-to-play match simulation on June 25 before the ODI and Test squads are expected to fly out on Oct 28 with the ODI series scheduled to start on Nov 4.

item.title: Houthis target Saudi Aramco compound, limited fire reported
item.description: A missile attack targeted Saudi Aramco's administrative building, damaging upper floors of the headquarters complex. Authorities reported intercepting multiple missiles and drones aimed at various regions, including Riyadh. In Riyadh, fragments from intercepted missiles injured four individuals and damaged several homes. This incident follows a series of Houthi missile attacks against Saudi targets in recent days. The situation remains tense as Saudi Arabia faces continued threats from Houthi forces.

This loss caused South Africa to drop to third place in the ICC World Test Championship standings. Australia, with nine wins from eleven matches, remains at the top of the table. Matt Renshaw was instrumental in Australia's success, scoring 190 runs in the first innings.

item.title: Martinez blasts Man United hierarchy; Rooney brands comments ‘disrespectful'
item.description: Lisandro Martinez criticised Manchester United’s hierarchy after their 2-0 Champions League defeat to Atletico Madrid, calling for greater investment in the squad. Wayne Rooney condemned the defender’s public remarks as “disrespectful” to teammates, questioning his motives and suggesting the club take action. Former United player Ashley Young agreed recruitment must improve but insisted players must perform with the squad they have.

item.title: Have varicose veins? 3 simple tips to follow before playing Garba this Navratri
item.description: Navratri festivities can be particularly tough for those with varicose veins due to the need for extended periods of standing. Vascular surgeon Dr. Sumit Kapadia offers helpful suggestions for enjoying Garba this season, including staying active, taking regular breaks, and elevating the legs to ease discomfort. For severe pain or swelling, it's crucial to consult a doctor before participating to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience.

item.title: El Clasico in Kolkata: Barca and Real icons set for Salt Lake clash on Nov 25
item.description: Kolkata will host Barcelona Legends vs Real Madrid Legends at Salt Lake Stadium on November 25, bringing El Clasico nostalgia to India. Luis Figo, Carles Puyol and Iker Casillas are among the names reportedly expected, though official squads remain unconfirmed. The exhibition follows last year’s meeting in Mumbai, where Real Madrid Legends won 2-0, and adds another chapter to Kolkata’s rich footballing history.
